recommendations.title: Organize RaT Improvement Briefs as dated digests with linked action items, not one endless page
recommendations.rationale: Daily briefs should be easy to scan today, review by date later, and convert into trackable work without burying decisions in a long scrolling feed.
recommendations.riskIfIgnored: Recommendations will pile up, operators will miss approved work, and the queue will become another graveyard instead of an operating system.
recommendations.approvalNotes: Recommended by the first RaT Improvement Brief. Proposed structure: /admin/recommendations for atomic recommendation cards, future /admin/improvement-briefs for dated digests, and approved recommendations linked to /admin/issues action items.
recommendations.implementationNotes: Do not implement until approved. Keep brief summaries separate from recommendation records; avoid infinite-scroll daily logs.

recommendations.title: Add a Bub command-context guardrail for short approvals like ‘post it’, ‘fix it’, and ‘ship it’
recommendations.rationale: Short approval phrases depend on recent context. Bub recently lost the AgAlmanac ‘post it’ context, which proves approval commands need a mandatory recall/history check before asking a dumb follow-up.
recommendations.riskIfIgnored: Approved work can stall, user trust drops, and the assistant wastes operator attention by forgetting the immediate thread.
recommendations.approvalNotes: Recommended as the required Bub/self-improvement item for the first daily brief.
recommendations.implementationNotes: Do not implement until approved. Proposed behavior: before responding to approval verbs, inspect recent session history and active child/queued work; if one matching pending item exists, act on it instead of asking what to post/fix/ship.

recommendations.title: Set AgAlmanac metadataBase so social/open-graph URLs resolve to production instead of localhost
recommendations.rationale: The AgAlmanac production build warns that metadataBase is missing, causing social Open Graph and Twitter image URLs to fall back to http://localhost:3000 during metadata resolution.
recommendations.riskIfIgnored: Shared links may have broken or inconsistent preview images, weakening blog/article distribution and making the product look less polished.
recommendations.approvalNotes: Recommended from May 11 build verification output after publishing the AgAlmanac article.
recommendations.implementationNotes: Do not implement until approved. Likely small change in AgAlmanac app/layout.tsx: metadataBase: new URL('https://agalmanac.app').

recommendations.title: Set an explicit Turbopack root for ratstudios-web builds
recommendations.rationale: The ratstudios-web build warns that Next.js is inferring the workspace root from multiple lockfiles and may pick the wrong directory.
recommendations.riskIfIgnored: Build behavior can become brittle as the monorepo/workspace grows, especially if tooling starts resolving files relative to the inferred root.
recommendations.approvalNotes: Recommended from May 11 ratstudios-web build verification output.
recommendations.implementationNotes: Do not implement until approved. Likely small change in next.config.ts to set turbopack.root to the project directory.

recommendations.title: Add a weekly portfolio security/dependency audit item to the improvement rhythm
recommendations.rationale: RaT Studios now has multiple active products and admin surfaces. A lightweight weekly audit keeps dependency, auth, secret, and permission drift visible before it becomes an incident.
recommendations.riskIfIgnored: Old packages, permissive policies, stale env vars, and auth/RLS mistakes can accumulate across apps without a clear owner noticing.
recommendations.approvalNotes: Recommended as the first portfolio-level security item in the RaT Improvement Brief rhythm.
recommendations.implementationNotes: Do not implement until approved. Proposed output: Friday security section with npm audit/dependency review, auth/RLS review notes, and top risks by app.

recommendations.title: Create a central Recommendations / Approval Queue in RaT Ops Admin
recommendations.rationale: Agent and app improvement recommendations need a durable place to be reviewed, approved, rejected, deferred, and later audited instead of disappearing in chat threads.
recommendations.riskIfIgnored: Good recommendations get lost, duplicated, or implemented without explicit operator approval, which weakens prioritization and accountability.
recommendations.approvalNotes: Approved for implementation as the first durable queue item.
recommendations.implementationNotes: Implemented as a file-backed JSON recommendations source with a read-only admin queue. No automation is attached to approvals.
